findings.title: Incomplete quote alternatives can receive full-grade credit without containing the requested answer

findings.title: Two causal questions are labelled with ordering-only evidence
findings.details: Rephrase to ordering, or add an independently cited causal source and re-review. Do not invent a reason from the native ownership/recovery design.

findings.title: Forty-two positive cases omit answer-equivalent original notes
findings.details: The scoring code rejects the other note ID even where it carries the complete same answer (bosun_19_0 is byte-identical). Do not add a duplicate as a separately required support group: that would demand two copies. Prefer remove/trim overlapping windows to one authoritative candidate per fact, or explicitly design same-fact curated-ID alternatives if preserving duplicates.

findings.title: Navigation graph nodes repeat the answer but are omitted from graph alternatives
findings.details: All80 positives omit file/topic/link IDs with the same text; for the narrow adequate-quote cases the text actually answers the question. Level2 candidates are emitted by the C source if owner approved and seeded. Gold scoring treats those IDs as irrelevant. Prefer retain entity/relation navigation metadata and remove copied answer text, or owner-review explicit legitimate graph alternatives. For incomplete quote cases, fix content first rather than adding more insufficient alternatives.

findings.title: Nominal100 queries reduce to40 positive gold assignments and20 copied graph texts
findings.details: Each gold assignment has two paraphrases; all five graph candidates per topic have identical text. One pair of source bodies is identical (19a/b), one contains the entire other (05a/b). Paired statistics must remain source/topic clustered, not claim80 independent positive facts. This is a corpus-design limitation, not evidence of forbidden tuning or cross-split ID leakage.

findings.title: Category names do not supply the accepted semantic coverage
findings.details: All9 summary cases are narrow single-fact lookups; all15 relationship cases have one support group and no required two-hop chain; all11 current cases have no competing old snapshot; four of seven rationale questions ask what/read/rule/condition rather than why, and the other two causal why questions need evidence. Graph contains20 disconnected file-topic edges and no fact endpoint, so traversal is not necessary to answer these questions. Add representative reviewed cases for broad summary, temporal conflict, causal rationale, ambiguous in-domain negatives and two-hop associations without changing held-out thresholds based on observed results.

findings.title: Twenty negatives are all external-platform absence queries
findings.details: All20 selected-source keyword scans are empty and the manual query review finds no answer in the corpus. Empty support is consistent, but these easy out-of-domain negatives do not test in-domain ambiguity, obsolete conflicting facts or wrong scopes. Near-miss/ambiguous cases need separate owner-reviewed labels; do not claim the private/scope/retention policy gates from this public project-only corpus.

findings.title: All five fenced-transfer graph texts reverse the two source fragments
findings.details: Graph text lists await control.fenceAdmission then fenced=true. Source has fenced=true at337 before await at338. It is labelled as excerpts, not an explicit execution sequence, but cannot safely provide ordering evidence. Use the contiguous337–338 span.

findings.title: Snapshot source integrity is proven; owner-authored/approved task evidence and native quality are not
findings.details: Owner selected Bosun repository data. Origin404 is recorded in the manifest and was not re-requested in this offline audit. Questions are Codex-authored from local uncommitted snapshots, not captured owner tasks or native sessions; evidence and reviewed flags deliberately remain pending. Owner approval must explicitly cover revised gold and graph derivatives. Do not claim public reachability, owner label approval, model quality, compilation, latency or native qualification from this audit.
